description: The bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs for different components across three stages of the Audio back-end Conformer. The horizontal axis represents the stages, labeled as Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3, with additional parameters (d and n) specified for each stage. The vertical axis is labeled "Module Giga FLOPs" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each stage is represented by a group of four bars, colored blue, red, yellow, and green, corresponding to "attention", "grouped attention (g=3)", "patch attention (k=3)", and "feed-forward" components, respectively. The bars within each group are of varying heights, with the blue bar being the tallest in each group, and the values decreasing from Stage 1 to Stage 3. Specifically, the blue bars have approximate values of 0.275, 0.17, and 0.14 for Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3, respectively. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
